title_en: Fall 2026 Doctoral Preliminary Review Schedule (August 2027 Graduation)
summary: Doctoral candidates expecting to receive their degree in August 2027 (who have passed the doctoral dissertation qualifying examination) must complete the doctoral preliminary review in Fall 2026, the semester before their initial and final reviews. They must submit the Committee Appointment Report between 12 and 26 October 2026, and the Dissertation Advising Result Report and International Journal Publication Confirmation (with a highlighted first-page copy of the paper, if applicable) between 14 December 2026 and 22 January 2027. All documents go to the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319).
applies_to: Doctoral students expected to receive the doctoral degree in August 2027 (August 2027 graduation). Only students who have passed the doctoral dissertation qualifying examination [논문제출자격시험] are eligible for the preliminary review. The preliminary review must be completed by the semester before the initial and final dissertation reviews; for August 2027 graduates, this means by the end of Fall 2026.

conditions: The notice may change later; check it regularly.
Only students who have passed the doctoral dissertation qualifying examination may take the preliminary review.
The preliminary review must be completed by the semester before the initial and final reviews.
All students must submit the International Journal Publication Confirmation, whether or not their paper has been published.
Students whose paper has not yet been published must complete the 'If the paper has not been published' [논문이 게재되지 않은 경우] section at the bottom of the form, with the advisor's signature (or seal).
Students with an international journal record must also submit a copy of the paper's first page; students without one submit only the first two documents.
The first-page copy must have your name, your advisor's name and the journal (or conference) name highlighted.
If you have an international journal record, write up and submit only one record.
On the Committee Appointment Report, all Seoul National University professors count as internal members.
The chair of the preliminary review committee is the advisor.
In the following semester (final review), two reviewers are added for a total of five, and the advisor becomes vice-chair.

Reviewers must be full-time, fund-supported, HK or non-full-time faculty of this university, or external experts holding a doctorate who are assistant professors or above at another institution, or researchers at a research institute with at least two years in the research field after the doctorate.
Appointing external members is permitted, and SNU emeritus professors may be appointed as reviewers.
There is no review fee and no online application for the preliminary review.
steps: Read the notice '2026학년도 2학기 논문심사 일정 안내 및 학위수여(논문 관련) 변경 규정 안내' (Fall 2026 Dissertation Review Schedule and Changes to Degree Conferral Rules) for the doctoral degree requirements on research output, and the related linked notices (not read in this translation).

Download the attached forms (Korean .hwp files): the Committee Appointment Report (Attachment 01) and the Dissertation Advising Result Report and International Journal Publication Confirmation (Attachment 02).
Complete the Committee Appointment Report with the advisor as chair, and submit it to the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319) between 12 and 26 October 2026.

Complete the Dissertation Advising Result Report and the International Journal Publication Confirmation; if your paper is not yet published, have your advisor sign (or seal) the 'If the paper has not been published' section.
If you have an international journal record, prepare a copy of the paper's first page with your name, your advisor's name and the journal (or conference) name highlighted.

Submit the documents in this order — (1) Dissertation Advising Result Report, (2) International Journal Publication Confirmation, (3) first-page copy (if applicable) — to the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319) between 14 December 2026 and 22 January 2027.
translation:
★ Fall 2026 Doctoral Preliminary Review Schedule (August 2027 Graduation)

※ The content of this notice may change later, so please check it regularly.

★ Eligibility for the doctoral preliminary review: students who have passed the doctoral dissertation qualifying examination [논문제출자격시험].

★ The doctoral preliminary review must be completed by the semester before the initial and final reviews [초심/종심].
Example: a student who takes the initial and final reviews in Spring 2027 and expects to receive the doctoral degree in August 2027 must complete the preliminary review by Fall 2026.

1. Applies to: students expected to receive the doctoral degree in August 2027 (August 2027 graduation).

2. Documents to submit
A. [Attachment 01] Committee Appointment Report [위원위촉보고서]: Monday 12 October 2026 to Monday 26 October 2026.
B. [Attachment 02] Dissertation Advising Result Report [논문지도결과보고서] and International Journal Publication Confirmation [국제학술지게재확인서]: Monday 14 December 2026 to Friday 22 January 2027.
★ If you have an international journal record, also submit document ③. If you have no record, submit only documents ① and ②.
※ Documents 1–3: please submit them in the following order.
① Dissertation Advising Result Report
② International Journal Publication Confirmation
③ (Applicable students only) Copy of the first page of the paper. ※ Highlighting is required: your name / your advisor's name / the name of the journal (or conference).

3. Where to submit: Department Administrative Office [학부행정실] (Building 301, Room 319). The staff contact is given in the original notice.

4. Notes
A. When completing the Committee Appointment Report, all Seoul National University professors are considered internal members.
B. The chair of the preliminary review committee is the advisor.
* For reference: in the following semester (final dissertation review), two reviewers are added, making five reviewers in total, and the advisor becomes vice-chair.
★ Reviewer qualifications
- Full-time faculty, fund-supported faculty, HK faculty or non-full-time faculty of this university.
- External experts holding a doctoral degree who meet one of the following:
(a) Faculty at another university: assistant professor or above.
(b) Researcher at a research institute: has worked in the research field for at least two years after obtaining the doctorate.
※ Appointing external members is permitted.
※ SNU emeritus professors may also be appointed as reviewers.
C. The International Journal Publication Confirmation must be submitted both by students who have published and by students who have not yet published. Students who have not yet published must complete the 'If the paper has not been published' [논문이 게재되지 않은 경우] section at the bottom of the form, including the advisor's signature (or seal), and submit it.
D. There is no review fee payment and no online application for the preliminary review.
E. If you have an international journal record, please write up and submit only one record.

5. References
① Doctoral degree requirements (regarding research output)
A. Explanation of items 1 and 2: refer to the notice 'Fall 2026 Dissertation Review Schedule and Changes to Degree Conferral Rules (Dissertation-related)' [2026학년도 2학기 논문심사 일정 안내 및 학위수여(논문 관련) 변경 규정 안내].
B. Notice on the 'List of conferences recognised as equivalent to international journals (SCI(E))': related notice (link; not read).
C. Notice on recognition of co-first authorship: related notice (link; not read).
② Internal rule 'Abolition of the oral examination in the dissertation qualifying examination; composition of the dissertation review committee': related notice (link; not read).

<Attachments>
01. Committee Appointment Report
02. Dissertation Advising Result Report, International Journal Publication Confirmation

Inquiries: Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319). Contact details are given in the original notice.

Attached files (2): 1. Doctoral Preliminary Review (Committee Appointment Report form).hwp (29 KB); 2. Doctoral Preliminary Review (Dissertation Advising Result Report and International Journal Publication Confirmation forms).hwp (28 KB). The contents of these attachments were not read.
